description.value: Jacks On The Water is a waterfront restaurant and bar that opened in 2024 on Sidney's Seaport Place, offering panoramic views of the Saanich Peninsula shoreline in a casual, inviting setting. The menu spans regional dishes, sushi (available daily), tacos, burgers, and shareable appetizers, with a first-come-first-served patio that welcomes well-behaved leashed dogs. Cyclists finishing a ride on the Lochside or Galloping Goose trails will find it a convenient stop just steps from the Sidney waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (16 spaces) at 37m; rack (5 spaces) at 76m. Total: 21 spaces.
